svg.text: Unbundle By Name grows by dragging its bottom edge; the field on each output is
chosen from a right-click menu, so the ORDER above is the order you pick, not alphabetical.
Every case of both Case Structures must wire both of its output tunnels, or the
run arrow breaks. Only the Fail and Skipped cases put anything in "row class".
The value-lookup loop takes step names and results as Last Value tunnels, NOT indexed:
each iteration searches the whole array for one bin name. Only the bin-name array is indexed.
cell sum, both Strip Path "name" outputs, UTC format?, initial string and Format Into
String's error terminals, N18 start index and N17 refnum out are deliberately left unwired.
branches routed down these lanes, around the loop
